overview: A comprehensive roadmap for aspiring and junior data scientists. Focuses on statistical analysis, business intelligence, data-driven insights, and effective communication of findings to stakeholders. Covers the full data science pipeline from collection to actionable business recommendations.

steps.title: Mathematics & Statistics Foundation
steps.description: Essential statistical concepts for analyzing data and drawing valid conclusions.
subtopics: Descriptive statistics: mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation
Probability distributions: normal, binomial, Poisson, uniform
Inferential statistics: confidence intervals, hypothesis testing
Statistical tests: t-tests, chi-square, ANOVA, Mann-Whitney U
Correlation vs causation, confounding variables
Bayesian thinking and Bayes' theorem
Experimental design and A/B testing fundamentals
Sample size calculation and power analysis

steps.title: Programming for Data Science
steps.description: Master programming tools essential for data manipulation and analysis.
subtopics: Python fundamentals: data types, loops, functions, libraries
Pandas: DataFrames, data cleaning, groupby, merging, pivoting
NumPy: arrays, mathematical operations, broadcasting
Jupyter notebooks: best practices, documentation, reproducibility
SQL: joins, subqueries, window functions, CTEs
Git and version control for data projects
Python environment management (conda, pip, virtual environments)
Data structures and algorithms basics

steps.title: Data Collection & APIs
steps.description: Learn to gather data from various sources and APIs.
subtopics: Web scraping with BeautifulSoup and Scrapy
REST APIs: requests library, authentication, rate limiting
Database connections: SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL
CSV, JSON, XML data formats
Survey design and data collection methodology
Data quality assessment and validation
Handling missing data and outliers
Data privacy and GDPR compliance basics

steps.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
steps.description: Discover patterns, anomalies, and insights in datasets.
subtopics: Data profiling: distributions, missing values, data types
Univariate analysis: histograms, box plots, summary statistics
Bivariate analysis: scatter plots, correlation matrices
Multivariate analysis: pair plots, heatmaps
Time series exploration: trends, seasonality, autocorrelation
Categorical data analysis: frequency tables, chi-square tests
Outlier detection: IQR, Z-score, isolation forests
Feature engineering and transformation

steps.title: Data Visualization & Storytelling
steps.description: Create compelling visualizations and communicate insights effectively.
subtopics: Matplotlib: basic plots, customization, subplots
Seaborn: statistical plots, aesthetics, color palettes
Plotly: interactive visualizations, dashboards
Chart selection: when to use bar charts, line plots, heatmaps
Color theory and accessibility in data visualization
Dashboard design principles
Storytelling with data: narrative structure, audience analysis
Presenting to technical vs non-technical stakeholders

steps.title: Statistical Analysis & Modeling
steps.description: Apply statistical methods to answer business questions.
subtopics: Linear and logistic regression: assumptions, interpretation
Time series analysis: ARIMA, seasonal decomposition, forecasting
Clustering: k-means, hierarchical, DBSCAN
Classification: decision trees, random forests, evaluation metrics
Dimensionality reduction: PCA, t-SNE, feature selection
A/B testing: design, sample size, statistical significance
Cohort analysis and retention metrics
Customer lifetime value (CLV) modeling

steps.title: Business Intelligence & Analytics
steps.description: Transform data into actionable business insights.
subtopics: KPI definition and metric development
Business case development and ROI analysis
Customer segmentation and personas
Marketing attribution modeling
Sales funnel analysis and conversion optimization
Churn prediction and retention strategies
Pricing analysis and elasticity modeling
Market basket analysis and recommendation systems

steps.title: Big Data Tools & Cloud Platforms
steps.description: Handle large datasets and leverage cloud computing for data science.
subtopics: SQL databases: optimization, indexing, query performance
NoSQL databases: MongoDB, document storage concepts
Apache Spark: DataFrames, distributed computing basics
AWS data services: S3, RDS, Redshift, Athena
Google Cloud Platform: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow
Data warehousing concepts: fact tables, dimensions, ETL
Data lakes vs data warehouses
Stream processing basics: Kafka, real-time analytics

steps.title: Advanced Analytics Techniques
steps.description: Apply sophisticated analytical methods for complex business problems.
subtopics: Causal inference: randomized experiments, natural experiments
Marketing mix modeling and attribution
Survival analysis and event prediction
Text analytics: sentiment analysis, topic modeling
Network analysis: social networks, recommendation systems
Optimization: linear programming, constraint optimization
Simulation and Monte Carlo methods
Multi-armed bandit testing and online experimentation

steps.title: Data Ethics & Communication
steps.description: Ensure ethical data practices and effective stakeholder communication.
subtopics: Data privacy: GDPR, CCPA, anonymization techniques
Algorithmic bias: detection, mitigation, fairness metrics
Reproducible research: documentation, version control
Peer review and validation of analytical findings
Executive reporting: executive summaries, key insights
Data governance and quality frameworks
Building data-driven culture in organizations
Communicating uncertainty and limitations

steps.title: Tools & Platforms Mastery
steps.description: Become proficient with industry-standard data science tools.
subtopics: Tableau: advanced visualizations, calculated fields, parameters
Power BI: data modeling, DAX formulas, report design
Excel: advanced functions, pivot tables, statistical analysis
R basics: data manipulation, ggplot2, statistical packages
Docker: containerizing data science workflows
Airflow: workflow orchestration, data pipelines
MLflow: experiment tracking, model versioning
GitHub: collaborative data science, project organization

steps.title: Project Ideas
steps.description: Comprehensive data science projects to demonstrate analytical skills and business impact.

examples.name: Customer Segmentation Analysis
examples.features: RFM analysis, clustering algorithms, customer personas, marketing recommendations, interactive dashboard
examples.stack: Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Plotly, Tableau, SQL

examples.name: Sales Forecasting Dashboard
examples.features: Time series modeling, seasonality analysis, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, executive reporting
examples.stack: Python, Prophet, Statsmodels, Plotly Dash, PostgreSQL

examples.name: A/B Testing Platform

examples.name: Marketing Attribution Modeling

examples.name: Churn Prediction & Analytics
examples.features: Survival analysis, customer retention modeling, intervention strategies, cohort analysis, predictive scoring

examples.name: Financial Risk Assessment
examples.features: Credit scoring models, portfolio analysis, stress testing, regulatory reporting, risk dashboards

examples.name: Social Media Analytics Suite
examples.features: Sentiment analysis, engagement metrics, trend detection, influencer analysis, competitive benchmarking
examples.stack: Python, NLTK, Twitter API, MongoDB, Tableau
